_comment: ALL-DIRECT panel. Zero OpenRouter — every seat talks to its own lab's API. This is the production/Hermes default: six labs, six independent transports, no single broker that can take the whole panel down.

_keys.GEMINI_API_KEY: gemini seat + the ONLY native video path
_keys.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: deepseek seat (api.deepseek.com) — judge panel only, text-only model

_notes: Six independent transports: no broker outage can take the panel below quorum, and each lab is billed and rate-limited separately.
deepseek-chat is text-only, so the deepseek seat is judge-panel only. It is also by far the cheapest seat, which is the point of having it.

Only the gemini seat receives the scroll RECORDING. Every other seat gets sampled keyframes flagged degraded:'video->frames' — not because those models cannot understand video, but because only the Gemini adapter serialises it (Files API). Do not assume a seat sees motion just because its model could.
Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY as well and the failover chain will use it as a backstop when a direct API is down. Direct is preferred, OpenRouter is the spare tyre.
For Hermes/VPS: keep these six in the VPS .env. verify:panel and doctor both run headless and exit non-zero on a bad seat, so they drop straight into a preflight step.
